definitions.explanation: A digital address, most commonly an email address or URL. In everyday Japanese, アドレス alone usually means email address.

examples.japanese: メールアドレス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me your email address.

examples.japanese: アドレス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{間違|まちが}えて→間違える：01109_machigaeru⟧⟦{別|べつ}→別：01216_betsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{送|おく}って→送る：00742_okuru⟧しまった。
examples.english: I made a mistake with the address and sent it to the wrong person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧アドレス⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}した→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{更新|こうしん}して→更新する：27994_koushinsuru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: I've changed to a new address, so please update your contacts.

notes:
From English "address." In Japanese, アドレス almost exclusively refers to digital addresses (email, web). For physical postal addresses, ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧ is used instead. Sometimes shortened to アド in very casual speech.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- メールアドレス: email address
- アドレス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change one's address
- アドレス⟦{帳|ちょう}→帳：10012_chou⟧: address book (contacts)
- アドレスバー: address bar (in a web browser)
- IPアドレス: IP address

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧: address (physical) — for postal/residential addresses
- URL: URL — specifically for web addresses, more technical
- ⟦{連絡先|れんらくさき}→連絡先：03191_renrakusaki⟧: contact information — broader, includes phone, email, etc.
